title: Create Lead
description: Create a new Lead / Opportunity linked to a client. Agents call this to capture inbound opportunities.

title: Schedule Site Visit
description: Book a site visit for a lead and automatically advance the lead stage to site_visit_scheduled.

title: Advance Lead Stage
description: Move a lead to a new pipeline stage and optionally add follow-up notes and next follow-up date.

title: Create Scope of Work
description: Create a Scope of Work linked to a lead. Sets status to draft and captures all cost/labor estimates.

title: Create Proposal
description: Create a Proposal from a Scope of Work. Links proposal to scope, lead, and client. Status defaults to draft.

title: Submit Bid
description: Submit a Bid from a Proposal. Creates the bid entity as submitted and advances the lead stage to bid_submitted.

title: Record Payment
description: Record a payment received against an invoice. Tracks method, amount, date, and QuickBooks reference.

title: Create Job from Contract
description: Create a Job / Project from a signed Contract. Job starts in pre_construction status.

title: Convert Won Bid to Contract
description: Mark a bid as awarded and create a new Contract linked to the winning bid. Two-step: update bid status then create contract.

title: Mark Contract Signed
description: Mark a contract as fully executed, set the signed timestamp, and optionally record the DocuSign envelope ID and document URL.

title: Create Invoice
description: Issue an Invoice against a Job. Sets issued_date to now and status to draft.
